[2026-10-10] c:6101212829 comment by winterrdog (contributor):
### "Targeted" Test Coverage Improvements
| Scope | Metric | Before (merge-base at cf80493e2367786ce9946c522eb8313a52c90557) | After (PR `HEAD`) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `src/torcontrol\.cpp$` | Lines | 71.7% (281/392) | 81.9% (321/392) | +10.2 pp (+40 lines) |
| `src/torcontrol\.cpp$` | Functions | 88.9% (24/27) | 96.3% (26/27) | +7.4 pp (+2 funcs) |
| `src/torcontrol\.cpp$` | Branches | 39.7% (265/668) | 47.9% (320/668) | +8.2 pp (+55 branches) |

to get these results, i only ran `feature_torcontrol.py` before and after the
change on the same build, using GCC's coverage instrumentation and lcov
`2.0`

bash script used to get test coverage locally

```sh
# 1. compile once with coverage baked in
cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Coverage
cmake --build build -j$(nproc)

# 2. BEFORE: run the merge-base version of the test file
git checkout $(git merge-base HEAD master) -- test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py
find build -name '*.gcda' -delete
python3 test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py --configfile=build/test/config.ini
lcov --capture --directory build --gcov-tool gcov-$(gcc -dumpversion | cut -d. -f1) \
     --rc branch_coverage=1 --ignore-errors inconsistent,mismatch,unused,negative \
     --output-file base.info

# 3. AFTER: run the PR version of the test file
git checkout HEAD -- test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py
find build -name '*.gcda' -delete
python3 test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py --configfile=build/test/config.ini
lcov --capture --directory build --gcov-tool gcov-$(gcc -dumpversion | cut -d. -f1) \
     --rc branch_coverage=1 --ignore-errors inconsistent,mismatch,unused,negative \
     --output-file after.info

# 4. keep only the file under test, then build the HTML report
lcov --extract base.info  '*/src/torcontrol.cpp' --rc branch_coverage=1 -o base_tor.info
lcov --extract after.info '*/src/torcontrol.cpp' --rc branch_coverage=1 -o after_tor.info
genhtml after_tor.info --baseline-file base_tor.info --branch-coverage -o cov_diff

## DONE...

# opens the system's default browser on linux. on other systems, just open the
# differential coverage report (./cov_diff/index.html) in your browser of choice
xdg-open cov_diff/index.html
```
